milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the 4-high iron block pillar and face it to demonstrate they have found and identified it. The iron block pillar center is at spawn-relative (4, 2, 10). max_distance=5 requires actual navigation toward the target (not just looking from spawn at ~10.8 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the iron block, confirming visual identification.
